Variants.Content: The warrior represents courage, honor and the ability to hold one's position in danger. Knights will pray for his favor before going into battle, and ordinary soldiers will whisper their names behind their shields; the fear on the battlefield will not disappear with prayer, but it will just give people more reasons not to run away.
